nodes.description: Owned constructor that assigns owner = msg.sender

totalSupply returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)]
balanceOf(address tokenOwner) returns balances[tokenOwner]

payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts
onlyOwner function performing an external transfer call on an arbitrary token address

safeDiv requires b > 0 and computes c = a / b

mapping(address => uint) balances of token holders

normalization_plan.reason: _newOwner is only used as the argument written into newOwner inside transferOwnership and carries no independent semantics
tokenOwner is only a lookup key for the balances mapping in balanceOf
to is only the destination index for the balances mapping write in transfer
tokens is only the amount fed to safeSub and safeAdd during a transfer
spender is only the second allowance key written by approve
from is only the source account index mutated by transferFrom
data is an opaque payload forwarded to the external callback in approveAndCall
tokenAddress is only the target of the external call made by transferAnyERC20Token
operand a is a purely positional argument of the arithmetic helper
operand b is a purely positional argument of the arithmetic helper
spender is both the allowance key and the external call target inside approveAndCall
balance is only the named return slot of balanceOf
remaining is only the named return slot of allowance
c is the shared named return slot of the SafeMath helpers and is resolved by the arithmetic operation it belongs to
success is a constant true return flag of the token transfer functions
